title: THE LONGSHOT KICKS THE SCREEN HARDER
why: His Q5: gun feel. The Longshot (170 damage, one shot every 1.6 s) used the generic heavy kick 4.5, about 1.9 px, the same as a Magnum before its pass. 7.0 is trauma 0.5, about 4 px, gone in 0.36 s, so it never stacks and the biggest hit has the biggest kick.
now: The Longshot now kicks the screen harder with every shot.

edits.replacement: var GUN_SHAKE={shotgun:6.5,smg:1.9,pistol:3.6,rifle:2.7,magnum:5.5,lmg:2.0,sniper:7.0};   // v28.xx (cw-kicksniper): the Longshot 4.5 to 7.0, one shot 1.9 px to about 4.1 px of camera kick (trauma 0.32 to 0.5, size 18 x trauma squared), draining in 0.36 s, far inside its 1600 ms rate, so 170 damage on one pull lands with the biggest kick of any gun
